canonical_project: Data Center National de N'Djamena (National Data Center)
owner: Government of Chad (PMICE programme) / Huawei Technologies (construction)
notes: Chad's national data centre in N'Djamena. US trade.gov (official): Huawei broke ground in July 2020, financed via China EXIM Bank concessional loan, part of the government's electronic communications infrastructure modernisation (PMICE). BuddeComm/GlobeNewswire (Jan 2022): national data centre plus 1,200km fibre network and 50km N'Djamena metro fibre. AfDB trans-Saharan fibre backbone (DTS) documents reference the 'Centre de Donnees National de Ndjamena'. As of 5 Feb 2026 (ndjamenaactu): phase 1 (building and equipment installation) complete; tripartite agreement between ADETIC, ANSICE and TECHSO-GROUP signed for audit/certification of the building and equipment - final step before inauguration; ~100 micro data centers installed in state institutions are to be connected to it. Not yet inaugurated as of check date; no public MW capacity figure.
